So everything I was taking was basically fighting my medication. Well, no wonder nothing was moving. And those Amazon supplements? Well, I started flipping over the bottles and most of them had 25 milligrams of magnesium. And you actually need 10 times that. The entire category was formulated for a normal gut, not one that's been slowed down by GLP-1. It was never going to work. Well, that is when I found this GLP-1 SOS. 250 milligrams of clinically studied magnesium that gently gets things moving without cramping or forcing. And it has ginger to help your stomach catch up. By week three, I was buttoning pants on Friday that fit like they did on Monday. And I didn't quit my shots. I'm down another 12 pounds and my grandkids hug me again. 55,000 people on a GLP-1 take this every day. And there's a 60-day money-back guarantee. So if it doesn't work, you get every dollar back. Now, fair warning. They sell out constantly because they just won't cut corners on doses. Go to GLP-1SOS.com. And if these are in stock, you better grab them.
